name: V60
steps: Rinse the paper filter with hot water; empty the server.
Add 20 g freshly ground coffee. Level the bed and tare.
Start the timer. Pour 40 g water; wait 30 seconds.
At 0:30, pour to 120 g total. Continue in 40-60 g pulses to 300 g. Keep the bed wet; finish near 2:30.

name: Chemex
steps: Place the filter with three layers facing the spout. Rinse and empty the brewer.
Add 30 g freshly ground coffee. Level the bed and tare.
Start the timer. Pour 60 g water; wait 45 seconds.
Pour in circles to 300 g total. Let the water level drop, then continue to 500 g. Let drain near 4:00.
